WildSpark 2.2.52 fixes the missing WildGroups invite sound.

- Play the battleground queue-pop sound on incoming group or raid invites.
- Fall back to Blizzard's standard group-invite sound if the queue sound is unavailable.
- Use numeric SoundKit IDs with `PlaySound` rather than a text name that could silently produce no sound.

The GitHub package workflow validates the release ZIP. The sound change could not be verified in a live game client.
